resources.string: This app is based on the open-source project Mika (Copyright 2026 wangzan101, https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika), modified and distributed by WOOW TECH CO., LTD., including the runtime launcher and its mika command and skill scripts. The full license text is at the top of this page; the changes are listed in docs-woowtech/FORK.md in the source repository, and upstream\'s NOTICE is kept with the source code.

The environment for running programs such as Python and Node, version 5.4.0, with one patch (PRoot ends all child processes when it exits). PRoot (GPL-2.0-or-later) and talloc (LGPL-3.0-or-later) ship with this app\'s installer as separate programs; the app does not link them. Their complete source code, patches and build scripts are on this app\'s GitHub Releases page with every version, as mika-<version>-gpl-sources.tar.gz; tools/sandbox/ in the source repository also has the source addresses, checksums, patches and build scripts, so you can rebuild them yourself.
Version 2.4.3, unmodified, statically linked into the PRoot program. It can be relinked with the source code and scripts in tools/sandbox/.
